scenarios.name: Multi-cause: payment CPU spike + shipping latency (trial 2)
Shared-host confounder: cart ↔ redis_cart (idx 24)
scenarios.confounder_description: Shared physical host CPU saturation affects both cart and redis_cart simultaneously. The correlation between them is due to the latent host-level confounder (U_host), NOT a direct causal link. FCI should produce cart ↔ redis_cart (bidirected). RIFT abstains when CID score is below threshold (L1).
